cards.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

Before you flip a coin to decide who goes first in a game, you may play this card. Don't flip that coin, and you go first. If both players play First Ticket, flip the coin as normal. (You may play only 1 First Ticket before you flip that coin.) You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
